ideas: What the skill is and why it appeals to you
How you plan to learn it
How it could change your life or career

phrases.meaning: wanted to for a long time
as fast or slow as I like

model: The skill I want to learn next is playing the guitar. I've always wanted to play an instrument, and actually, I used to take piano lessons when I was about eight. My mum would drive me to a teacher's house every Saturday morning, but I didn't enjoy it very much, and I stopped after a year. I no longer remember anything from those lessons, so I'd basically be a complete beginner. The reason I've chosen guitar is that it's portable and it's perfect for playing with friends. At university, one of my classmates used to bring his guitar on every trip, and we would sit around at night singing together. Those are some of my favourite memories, and I'd love to be the person who can do that. I've been putting it off for years because I'm busy with work, but I've finally decided to sign up for an online course that lets me learn at my own pace. My plan is to set aside about twenty minutes every evening, and maybe join a weekend group class later on. I know the first few months will be frustrating, especially because my fingertips will hurt, but I really want to stick with it this time. I think it would be a great creative outlet and a nice break from staring at a laptop all day.
